==Summary==
<small>{{color|old|Disclaimer: This is a compilation of Skip summary and may not reflect the accuracy of story.}}</small>
{{Description|
At the crossroads leading towards Mengzhou, you and Yangyang see Suisui off. Suisui plans to head to Mengzhou to gather intel on Mengzhou City Hall and Zhuojun Atelier, while Yangyang joins Ministry of War patrols around Xuanfang Hold. You, meanwhile, set out for Fogveil Pagoda, the place where Suisui once obtained a Prism of Fate, to search for leads on Sentinel Hsin. Just before you leave, you and Yangyang hear the distant melody of a qin...

High in the mountains, Qingxiao sits in quiet meditation, playing her qin, when she catches a Rafter Kite and recognizes it as a messenger from Hsin the Moon Fox. The sight stirs a memory—Hsin once came to her in person, entrusting her with the safety of Xuanfang Hold's people and granting her the authority to act in the Sentinel's stead, should the situation ever reach a point of no return. Sensing that the time has come, Qingxiao sets out at once for Fogveil Pagoda, determined to find the long-missing Hsin.

You and Qingxiao cross paths at Fogveil Pagoda, both searching for Hsin. The pagoda's mechanisms are malfunctioning, and Tacet Discords are breaking loose for unknown reasons. Together, you decide to investigate the chamber that once held the Prism of Fate.

You and Qingxiao search Hsin's chamber together but find no trace of Her frequency. With Abby's help, you come across a mysterious Qingfu pendant, seemingly a clue left behind by the "Cat of the Nether Lamp," the Nethermancer who once worked with Suisui. Following this lead, you head to Xianling Village to ask the locals about it.

The moment you reach the high ground above Xianling Village, the Four Chime Shaftpost sounds the alarm. Tacet Discords are attacking the village, and chaos has broken out. You rush in to help.

The villagers tell you that Autopuppets across the region have been shutting down, and Fogveil Pagoda isn't the only place with such anomalies. The coins on the pendant you found seem tied to Mengzhou's Nethermancers. The villagers suggest you ask Granny Yanshu, who lives near the village gate.

At the Yanshu family's home, you find an old painting of Qingxiao and a Xuanling Bird from years past. Reading the frequency left on the painting, you catch a hazy glimpse of Qingxiao protecting an unfamiliar young girl. As you're discussing the painting, Yanshu steps into the courtyard.
A family is tending to a badly wounded Xuanfang Warden who was hurt covering their escape. At a little girl's request, Qingxiao uses her Quietude Art to ease the soldier into peaceful sleep. You notice she seems a little downhearted, aware that her ability cannot take away the soldiers' true pain.

You regroup with the Warden Commander and Yangyang to plan your next move. You suspect something may have gone wrong inside the Sanctum, the home of Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe, and that Muyu's true body could be hiding there, in the one place no one has searched. After discussion, you and Qingxiao are chosen to investigate the Sanctum while Yangyang and the others hold the line around the Ministry of War. Since defenses are not fully in place yet, you will rest for the night and set out the next day. Qingxiao slips away, apparently to make some preparations of her own...

Following the sound of a qin, you find Qingxiao playing in a pavilion near the Ministry of War. She is using the music to distribute protective Sword Intent to Xuanfang's soldiers and civilians as a safeguard. She explains why she arrived late to the earlier crisis: Muyu had set a trap, taking wounded soldiers hostage and forcing her to single-handedly fight off an entire Censure Court while protecting them. Now, with the Land of Xuanfang badly weakened and another crisis looming, Qingxiao cannot help blaming herself. Your words help her let go of her guilt and focus on what she can do now, sharing her Sword Intent with everyone who needs it. Under the bright moon, to the drift of her music, you stay quietly by her side...

The next day, you meet up with Qingxiao and Yangyang at the Ministry of War. Defenses around the Ministry are now complete, and a fresh unit of Midnight Rangers has arrived as reinforcement, though some abnormal modular parts have appeared nearby. After saying goodbye to Yangyang, you and Qingxiao set off for the Sanctum.

The Sanctum's gate remains sealed, and not even using your Resonance Energy to activate the Prism of Fate can force it open. Surprisingly, it activates the Qingfu pendant instead, revealing a hidden passage that appears to lead inside the Sanctum. It seems whoever left the pendant intended for you to find this way in. With no other option, you and Qingxiao enter.

Inside the Sanctum, you encounter Jingran, the Cat of the Nether Lamp, amid a thick fog. He attacks without warning. After a brief clash, you gain the upper hand, while Qingxiao faces off against a phantom projection of Muyu nearby. Muyu shows little interest in stopping you, and Jingran withdraws as well, apparently satisfied with merely testing your skill in battle. You discover that Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe has been corrupted by Reverberations and is likely the source of the disturbance. At that moment, the Prism of Fate begins to react...

You shield Qingxiao as the two of you fall and crash to the ground. You wake one after another in an unfamiliar valley. Your Terminal is unresponsive, and Abby does not answer your calls. Traces of battle are scattered around, and Qingxiao senses something deeply off about the place. You decide to find higher ground to get your bearings.

Near Yuan Fortress's mountain gate, an elderly woman and a young man tell you Jinzhou is soon to be established. Although, it appears the mountain gate is closed to visitors.

The gates of Yuan Fortress do not open. This Mirage Realm you and Qingxiao find yourselves in resembles the Land of Xuanfang from two hundred years ago and feels unnervingly real, except history has taken a different course here: Yuan Fortress was never destroyed in the Fortress and Gorges War. A mysterious Autopuppet calling itself Jadie appears before you and points you skyward, explaining that to catch up with the speeding Cloud Shuttles, you'll need to take a side path leading to a distant lightway. The moment it finishes speaking, it shuts down. You head for the path near the mountain gate.

Aboard a Cloud Shuttle, you question an Artisan who appears to be in charge and learn what has transpired. According to local accounts, a "Transcendent" recently appeared and taught the people miraculous mechanist arts, enabling the Ministry of Development and Zhuojun Atelier to build this Shuttle-borne Xuanfang Hold in mere months. Not long ago, the newly launched fleet wiped out a Tacet Discord outbreak unleashed by Ovathrax and won the Fortress and Gorges War without incident. The Artisan adds that the Transcendent is currently stationed on the foremost shuttle.

You find a sword embedded upright in the ground. The frequency clinging to it conjures a vision of the past: a young girl named Ruoyun, guided up the mountain by a Xuanling Bird, once sought out Qingxiao and pleaded with her to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak threatening the village.

Most of the Artisans aboard the Cloud Shuttle appear indifferent to the Autopuppets' unrest. From Shitang and Chigong, you learn that many Artisans have been acting strangely lately, even admitting to themselves that something feels wrong. Shitang asks you to check on a friend of hers who has seemed particularly listless recently.

Qingxiao confides that, as far as she can recall, most of the Artisans aboard this Shuttle are among those who perished when Yuan Fortress self-destructed. Back then, the last Artisans and soldiers holding the Fortress had no choice but to detonate it to prevent the Tacet Discords from reaching Mengzhou. Qingxiao had been in the Gorges of Spirits supporting local forces at the time, and by the time she returned to Xuanfang, Yuan Fortress was already in ruins, and with it, those who had made their final stand there.

The so-called "Transcendent" proves to be Muyu, as expected. He is using this Mirage Realm as his personal laboratory, rewriting the memories of the departed Artisans to construct a perfect "Xuanfang Hold as it was always meant to be." He informs you that every Cloud Shuttle here was rebuilt from technical blueprints already in the database, blueprints Hsin the Moon Fox could have used to change the course of the Fortress and Gorges War, yet chose not to...

You rescue Jadie from an Autopuppet attack. It appears to have just caught up with you. Jadie directs you higher into the sky, toward the "Di Realm." Pressed for more information, Jadie hesitates, clearly torn, but admits that conditions in the real Xuanfang Hold are deteriorating.

Conditions around Xuanfang Hold continue to worsen: more Censure Courts have gone dark, and Tacet Discord hordes are closing in. As Yangyang rallies the vanguard troops before battle in her new role as Xuan Watcher, Liangyu returns, recovered and ready to fight alongside her. Together with the soldiers, they prepare to meet the oncoming hordes.

Jadie asks you to press on without it, warning you to beware of the Di Realm's Reeling Fog, and claiming time to make preparations before rejoining you. You head for the lightway leading into the Di Realm.

Not long ago, the Cat of the Nether Lamp meets with Muyu aboard a Cloud Shuttle. Muyu asks for his thoughts on the Reverberations of the dead, then demonstrates how a Reverberation can drive an Autopuppet entirely on its own. Once the Autopuppet stirs to "life," Muyu orders him to dispose of it. The Cat of the Nether Lamp outwardly complies with Muyu's test, but secretly preserves the Reverberation instead...

Aboard a Cloud Shuttle in the Di Realm, you stumble on an unusual "Autopuppet village" where its inhabitants appear to live ordinary lives like regular villagers. With the pendant's help, you see the truth: they are all souls of the departed, another one of Muyu's cruel experiments, it seems. While the Autopuppet village chief retrieves a sword left behind by someone, you notice Qingxiao appears unwell...

The frequency on the sword reveals a memory of Ruoyun bidding farewell to Qingxiao. Qingxiao tells you the Fortress and Gorges War broke out soon after, and that Ruoyun was among those who carried out Yuan Fortress's self-destruction.


(Work in Progress)

It is vast enough to enshroud the entire Hold.<br />It served as a crucial line of protection during the earlier siege by the Autopuppets.}}, have failed.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 2.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' Holding the main gate is no longer viable. We must fall back, line by line, and rally everyone around the Ministry of War. It is the sturdiest ground we have left.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 3.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Only a few Tacet Discords have slipped into the Hold so far. We still have time to set up our defenses... Ah, you're here.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 4 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 4 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Any word on what caused this incident?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 5.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' Our tally shows nearly three in ten Censure Courts have stopped cold. The Ministry of Development has yet to determine why. This is not a simple malfunction.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 6.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Earlier, while patrolling near the Skyworks with the others, we ran into a pack of Tacet Discords that had just broken loose.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 7.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We fought our way through and found a nearby Censure Court shut down. Autopuppets fallen all around. It was as if every mechanism... gave out at once.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 8.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' If anything could trigger anomalies of this magnitude, it would have to be...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 9.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The Sanctum.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 10.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' It is Hsin's residence, and the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 11.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' Precisely. There may have been a change inside. Looking back, we overlooked something in our earlier operations—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 12.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' Tacet Discords and Autopuppets were not a concern within the Hold, so we assumed the Sanctum was safe. We posted only a handful of guards along the main approaches.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 13 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 13 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' When the Ministry of War searched for Muyu's true body, did anyone search inside the Sanctum?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 14.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' {{Rover}}, you mean... Muyu...
:{{DIcon}} He might be hiding inside the Sanctum.
:{{DIcon}} He might be hiding in plain sight.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' During the fight... Muyu hinted that his attack on Xuanfang Hold had another purpose—

:<div style="margin: 2px 0px">[[File: Song of the Heart Sword CG Yangyang Fighting Myriad Snare.png|500px]]</div>
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 18.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' ...Pathetic fools. You have guarded this Hold for over two hundred years, yet still you're blind to its fundamental nature.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 19.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' I am but a single step away from my <b>destination</b>. Anything that stands in my way now is nothing more than a momentary diversion.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 20.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' He sowed such chaos. Threw lives away... just so he could clear a path to the Sanctum.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 21.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' During the Siege of Xuanfang Hold, all eyes were on the fierce battle around the main gate... The Sanctum could indeed have been infiltrated.
:{{DIcon}} In any case, we should inspect the Sanctum.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 23 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 23 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' We can't be sure yet, but too many signs point to the Sanctum: Muyu's escape. The Censure Courts shutting down. The Sentinel missing.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 24 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 24 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' It may well be the source of this disturbance. If we're lucky, we might find the truth and some trace of Hsin the Moon Fox there.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 25.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I will go with you. The Sanctum's mechanisms are intricate and ever-shifting. A moment's carelessness could make you lose your way.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 26.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Hsin once received me there as a guest. I can serve, at least, as a guide.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 27.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' "None may enter the Sanctum without the Sentinel's leave" has always been the Hold's iron law. But now... we cannot afford to observe it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 28.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' If the Mengzhou City Hall assigns blame afterward, I will bear full responsibility. Let them strip my rank again. It matters not. But...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 29.ogg}} '''Qiuhong:''' The city's fortifications are not yet finished. I must ask you both to stay the night and leave at dawn. We can't be too careful.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 30.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I'll see the rest of the preparations through with the Wardens. Come what may, we'll be ready.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 31.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' {{Rover}}, you and Paragon Qingxiao should relax tonight. Prepare for whatever awaits you in the Sanctum.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 32.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Then I will rely on you, Yangyang.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 33 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 33 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...Qingxiao?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 150 34.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I have preparations to attend to.

::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 5.ogg}} '''Friendly Artisan:''' Ah, so you are under her tutelage... That is why she keeps company.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 6.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 7.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I remember you. You are Anyan.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 8.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Indeed, I am. I was once with the Ministry of Development's Defenseworks. Now, I serve on the Cloud Shuttle's maintenance crew.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 9.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Had you not held back the Tacet Discords when Yuan Fortress was first built, none of us would have lived to see Xuanfang Hold rise.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 12 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 12 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' This is the City of Mechanisms built with the aid of Mengzhou's Sentinel, right?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 13.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Sentinel...? Forgive me, but I don't quite follow.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 15.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Sentinel Hsin, the Moon Fox. Isn't she the reason Xuanfang Hold and these Shuttles exist?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 16.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Why would you also—Never mind. I shall brief you on the recent tidings.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 17.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' A <b>Transcendent</b> excelling in mechanist arts came to Xuanfang and taught us wondrous techniques. It was like learning how to turn stone into gold.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 18.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Mountains, pebbles, pearls, rough stone—anything could be turned into a mechanism. And those mechanisms could evolve and replicate on their own. With that knowledge, the Ministry and Zhuojun Atelier raised this magnificent city in just a few months.
:<div style="margin: 2px 0px">[[File: Song of the Heart Sword CG Cloud Shuttle.png|500px]]</div>
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 19.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' As for the Shuttles, they were first tested in real combat two weeks ago.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 20.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' We were on board, yet we barely had to lift a finger. They hunted and exterminated the Tacet Discords on their own.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 21.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' And for the tight spots they couldn't reach, we deployed Autopuppets. Like soldiers falling from the sky, scouring the earth clean.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 22.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' In a single day and night, from Yuan Fortress to the Gorges of Spirits, the Threnodian of War's vanguard was reduced to nothing.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 23.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Now, our Shuttles provide reinforcement across all of Huanglong. One fleet has already left for the Norfall Barrens, to protect the newly founded Jinzhou City.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 25 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 25 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...I'd like to know more about this Transcendent.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 29.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' Strange thing is, none of us can remember his face. Or his voice. Probably another one of his mystical tricks.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 270 30.ogg}} '''Anyan:''' If you want answers, board the Shuttle at the head of the fleet. The Transcendent is staying there.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 1.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' At last, you arrive. I hope my little "roadblocks" weren't too much trouble for you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 4.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' And where is that ignorant, chattering little girl? The strike she landed last time... It left an impression.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 5.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I will grant you a swifter end this time.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 6.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Easy now, Sword Transcendent. Surely you realize I am but a phantom.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 7.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Why not stay for a chat? You must have questions. I would be disappointed if you didn't.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 8 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 8 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' What have you done to the minds of the Artisans in this Mirage Realm?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 9.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' This is Xuanfang as I have shaped it. A better version of what stood here two hundred years ago.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 10.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Those Artisans are shadows of the past. I offered them a kindness— adjusted their perception, excised their emotional flaws. Now they are on their way to becoming perfect.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 12.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' You should understand, Qingxiao. A heart unsullied by desire or feeling, is that not the ideal state you Cultivators chase?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 13.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Cultivation is not about making oneself an unfeeling lump of wood.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 14.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Lump of wood...? No, no. This is perfection. Xuanfang Hold as it was always meant to be.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 15.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Everything you see runs itself. Perfect order. Perfect efficiency. With mechanisms like these, we could fight another Fortress and Gorges War and lose no one.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 16.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' I am sick to death of those "Hero Plays" about devotion and sacrifice.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 17.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' They stir the heart, yes. But that is all they do. The weak swallow them because the truth is too bitter to bear.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 20.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' You have no right to judge them, Muyu.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 21.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Heh... I built Yuan Fortress. I understand the limits of humanity far better than powerful Resonators like you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 22.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' When the Fortress fell, when our struggle meant nothing against the Lament, the one meant to "guide civilization" just stood there. Watching.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 23.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' The Xuanfang Hold you see now? This is what it was supposed to be. I just restored it from the blueprints in the database. Which is to say—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 24.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' It could have changed the course of the war. So what do you think? Did our Sentinel Hsin lack the power? Or... did She lack the will?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 25 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 25 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Suspect the Sentinel all you want. Your fall from grace is your own doing.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 26 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 26 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' All I see is a coward hiding in a Mirage Realm, running experiments that are only fooling himself.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 27.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Wherever your true body is hiding, I will find it. And I will end you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 28.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' I look forward to it. There's just one thing...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 320 29.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Where did you get the idea that this place couldn't affect reality?

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 353 1.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' You've been gone for quite a while.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 353 15.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Which is why I need a small favor... Dispose of that sample for me.

:{{Readable|(There's messy handwriting crammed into the margins, seemingly added bit by bit over time.)<br><br>Shifu once mentioned some Nethermancer who tracked a Mirage Realm, snuck into the Sanctum... and got mysteriously dumped right back at the entrance.<br><br>Heh. Bet you anything that "Nethermancer" was him.<br><br>So this Mirage Realm was probably here in the Sanctum the whole time, not something Muyu created. Well, we're still inside the Sanctum, at least.<br><br>...<br><br>Apart from the ground, this Mirage Realm roughly divides into three layers: the {{Rubi|Ren|Human}} Realm, the {{Rubi|Di|Earth}} Realm... and the one above them, which I guess should be called the "{{Rubi|Tian|Heaven}}Realm." Each layer's got its own Cloud Shuttles running. And there's this lightway hanging right before the whole fleet, the only way to move between layers.<br><br>Could that lightway be our ticket out of here? Need to check.<br><br>...<br><br>It's confirmed. Muyu still doesn't have full control over these Cloud Shuttles and Autopuppets. So he's basically squatting in this Mirage Realm at the end of the day.<br><br>Sure, he can somehow order the Autopuppets to attack.<br><br>But it's more like... he's hijacking the Cloud Shuttles' own defense systems.<br><br>Mostly he just rigged the mechanisms with this mist laced with Reverberations. That's how he got into the Sanctum in the first place. It's actually some kind of Disorienting Fog, and it spreads fast, corrupts fast. Any regular mechanism that touches it goes haywire real quick.<br><br>Stay sharp, {{Rover}}.|title=Scribbled Note I}}

:{{Readable|Now, let's talk about Muyu.<br><br>On the surface, he's a madman who won't shut up about his plans and ideals. But the guy's actually careful. Real cagey. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 1.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' You killed the Crownless and flew back to Xuanfang without a moment's rest. And still... too late.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 2.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' Mortal lives are but motes of dust. You know this. Even if this war had never come, another would. Or the Lament would burn it all to ash.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 30.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' From Yuan Fortress, to the Gorges of Spirits, to the Land of Xuanfang... No matter how hard I try, my sword cannot save everyone.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 14.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Ngh... Do not run.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 15.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' You want my power?!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 16.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' Have you lost your mind? I am the {{Rubi|Sanshi Poison|Three Corpses Poison}} in your body! The emotions and desires you cut away for the sake of cultivation!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 17.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' Every dark thought, every shadow your sword ever cast... They are me! Other Cultivators would have slain me long ago, yet you seek my help?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 18.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...Our Heart Swords were always meant to be one.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 19.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' You... You kept me for two centuries. Fed me your feeings. All so you could use me when the day came.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 20.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' You are Qingxiao too, after all.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 21.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Cultivation is, above all, being true. If I killed you... how could I claim an honest heart?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 22.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' You will regret this. I will eat away at you until nothing is left. No mind. No heart. In the end, your own hand will tear down everything you tried to protect.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 23 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 23 f.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Even if that day comes... I have someone by my side who can stop me. I am willing to entrust myself to {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 24.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' Qingxiao, the things you treasure are not the things I treasure. You care for the world. But I...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 25.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' I only care about your Way.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 26.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Yes. I know.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 31.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' From this day forth, you will never be able to sever the full tide of mortal feeling, or break free from the karma of this world.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 27.ogg}} '''Inner Demon:''' You will be bound to me forever. Never to see through the world's illusions. Never to transcend. Never to attain the Way.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 28.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I was never a Transcendent. I need not bother with any great Way. Besides... I have already found my <b>answer</b>.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 490 29.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' How very stubborn... {{Rubi|I am|you are}}.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 21.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The Golden-Eyed One and Jué.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 22.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' You struck the source of the disaster. You rewrote the fate of that war.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 23.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I looked for you after the battle, but you were gone. I wanted to know if someone like you ever had to face such impossible choices.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 24 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 24 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I still don't know my past. And nothing I've been through since I woke up has been simple or easy.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 25 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 25 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' But even though we didn't always know how things would turn out, we still followed our hearts anyway. And we gave it everything we had.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 26.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Yes, we did. I must confess, {{Rover}}, I... lied to you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 27.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The Ministry of Foreign Affairs's reach is not that wide. I actually traced your footsteps by asking many people.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 28.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Come, my disciple. Time to settle things in the world outside.
:{{DIcon}} Say that again?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 30.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...I want to be honest with myself. Since I taught you Sword Flight, I do consider you my disciple.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 491 31.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' You need not answer, but I shall call you such... even if only for this short while.

;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Leave the inner landscape when you're ready
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 1.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Before we depart, is there anything you wish to ask? Time flows much faster here than out there. We still have a moment.
:{{DIcon}} I do have a few questions.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 21.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I see. Ask away.
::{{DIcon|Option}} Is this place your inner world?
:::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 6.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Yes. This {{Extra Effect|Inner Landscape|Inner Landscape|An inner world that only a small number of cultivators can enter during deep meditation, where every blade of grass and every tree is a projection of the mind.<br />This mirage realm is also known by the more common name "Mindscape."}} manifests during my meditations. It is a reflection of my state of mind.
:::{{DIcon}} How did I get in here?
:::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 8.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...That strand of {{Extra Effect|Lifebound Sword Intent|Lifebound Sword Intent|A unique frequency of Sword Intent split off by Qingxiao, condensing her most essential and purest Resonance Energy.}} I gave you has, to a certain extent, bound our lives to the same wellspring.
:::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 9.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' When my Resonance Energy ran dry, my Inner Demon surfaced. My inner landscape began to collapse. That is how you were pulled in. But...
:::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 23.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' It was also my wish. If I failed, you would've had the strength to stop me.
::{{DIcon|Option}} What of your inner demon? Are you alright?
:::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 12.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Do not worry. My mind has settled. My Resonance Ability is stabilizing. I am far from full strength, but I will not lose control again.
:::{{DIcon}} You have me. No more soloing it, okay?
:::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 15.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Yes. I have you by my side.
::{{DIcon|Option}} What's the situation at the Ministry of War?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 16.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I have been sensing the battle through my Sword Intent. The line is holding. The soldiers and people of Xuanfang stand united. They will protect the Hold.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 500 17.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' But that is all we can burden them with. The rest falls on us... We must end Muyu's schemes without delay.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} I'll stay here a bit longer.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Let's head out.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 1.ogg}} '''???:''' Heh. {{Rover}}, Paragon Qingxiao. Took you long enough. Any later, and I wouldn't've held out.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 2.ogg}} '''???:''' That pendant and those notes I left... They did the trick, I s'pose?
:{{DIcon}} Cat of the Nether Lamp.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 5.ogg}} '''"Cat of the Nether Lamp":''' Just a Jianghu alias to earn my keep. Let me introduce myself proper—
:{{DIcon}} Our inside man. We meet again.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 6.ogg}} '''"Inside Man":''' Sounds a bit dull. I'd much rather you call me—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 7.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' The Nethermancer who went three years undercover in Zhuojun Atelier's snake spit without a single bite—Jingran. You didn't pull any punches back at the Sanctum, by the way.
:{{DIcon}} Neither did you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 9.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Haha! Heard stories 'bout your style. Had to see for myself if the rumors were true.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 10 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 10 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Your cover must be blown now, right?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 11.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' I hit him first.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 12.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' While he was running his mouth at you, I gave him a little love tap in the back. Shame he slipped away behind a wall of Autopuppets.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 13.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I see... that's why Muyu's phantom vanished so suddenly.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 14.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 15 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 15 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 16.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 17.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 18 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 18 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' That's your only condition?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 19.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Yeah, well... if we trip over any Sanctum relics or Hsin's secret stash of treasure, maybe toss one my way? Hah. Kidding.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 20.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Let me be clear, no Nethermancer stands by while someone toys with the dead's {{Rubi|Reverberations|obsessions}}.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 21 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 21 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Then... pleasure working with you?
:{{DIcon}} (Extend your hand to Jingran)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 23.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Likewise.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 24.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Where's Muyu's true body hiding?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 25.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' He took the Shuttle up to the top level. The {{Rubi|Tian|Heaven}} Realm. That's his playground.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 26.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' According to "Lucky," there's a sea of Reverberations up there. Almost like... all of Xuanfang's Reverberations got sucked into one place.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 27.ogg}} '''Lucky?:''' To hell with you, I told you that's not my name! You forgetful brat!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 28.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Tch. Always so lively... That's just a foul-mouthed {{Extra Effect|Lynx Spirit|Lynx Spirit|A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.}} I caught. Pay it no mind.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 29.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...What's Muyu's true intention?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 30.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' In a coded letter to Zhuojun Atelier, he claimed he'd get his hands on "Sentinel technology." The mechanistic mojo Hsin used to build the Hold.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 31.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' But think about it. If all he wanted was to steal something in the Sanctum... isn't all this chaos a bit unnecessary?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 32 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 32 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' He's been running experiments on the mechanisms. It's like he's trying to figure out how they work before he does something.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 33 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 33 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Either way, we need to find him quickly.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 34.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' This is the last Shuttle, but I see no lightway to the Skyend Barrier.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 35 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 510 35 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Let's check near that Swordlight.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 1.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Looks like you still have questions. Go on. I got nothing to hide.
:{{DIcon|Option}} How did you get here?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 6.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' After our little run-in at the Sanctum, I used a <b>Spirit Portal</b> to enter this Mirage Realm. Landed in this level first.
::{{DIcon}} Spirit Portal?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 19.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Same portal I opened for you back then. It cuts a passage between any two places thick enough with Reverberations.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 7.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' As soon as I got there, I walked right into Muyu collecting data. Played along, got cozy. After my cover blew, I stole a Shuttle to give his toys the slip. That's how I ended up here.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 8.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Lucky or not, you two showed up. With a parade of those things. Heh. Gotta say, you really know how to wear a guy out.
:{{DIcon|Option}} Why did you just leave that pendant behind?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 9.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Right before the siege, Muyu and I reached a secret chamber in Fogveil Pagoda. He didn't find Hsin's trail, so he geared up for the Sanctum.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 10.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Time was tight, so I left that pendant behind as a breadcrumb. Laced it with my Resonance Ability. Then I followed him.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 11.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' It was a gamble. Could've blown up in my face a hundred ways. But turns out... I bet on the right horse. Spent my life in the right place, too.
::{{DIcon}} Wait... "spent your life"?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 13.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Oh, I cut a deal with the "debt collector" in this {{Rubi|lamp|Life Lamp}}. Traded a bit of my lifespan. Just enough to juice that pendant.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 14.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Add in the passage to the Sanctum? A year or two off the clock. I figure that's a tidy price for you and the Paragon on my side.
:{{DIcon|Option}} How did you manage to get close to Muyu?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 15.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' The snake needed a hand from within Zhuojun Atelier to get supplies moving to lay the groundwork. That hand... just happened to be me.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 16.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' But he was paranoid. Notes at drop points, never a face. Didn't get a meet‑and‑greet 'til all hell broke loose with the Autopuppets.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 511 17.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' He kept me at arm's length. Used me like a doorman. If you two hadn't've scared him, he never would've let me come this far.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} I'll ask later.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 8.ogg}} '''Jadie:''' Alrighty! Now I'll scoot us along to the next level—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' The Prism of Fate...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 10.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Whoa. So that's the Moon Fox's relic from Fogveil Pagoda? Figured it ended up with you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 11.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Ruoyun?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 12.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' ...Yes. Sword Transcendent Qingxiao... It has been... a very, very long time.
:{{DIcon}} What? Jadie, what just happened?
:{{DIcon}} Explain yourself. And don't try to dodge.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 15.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' Uhh... How was I supposed to know the Sentinel's relic would reveal my true form like that?!

:{{DIcon}} I've heard bits of it.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 20.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Good, saves time. The story goes that the Savantae crew didn't just vanish after building the Hold. They just... "upgraded." Celestials, they call 'em. Been watching over the city's mechanisms ever since.
:{{DIcon}} "Celestials"? What are they?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 21.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Celestials... That's the name they gave the Savanate crew that built the Hold. Soon after its completion, poof. Gone without a trace.
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 22.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' But if you buy the old stories, they never really left. Just became invisible caretakers keeping the Hold's gears turning to this day.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 23.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The Fortress and Gorges War broke out before Xuanfang Hold was even finished. Ruoyun, what exactly are you...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 24.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' Very good. I am a Celestial. But my case... was a little different.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 25.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' Long ago, I triggered the self-destruct at Yuan Fortress's mainframe—

:<div style="margin: 2px 0px">[[File:Song of the Heart Sword CG Ruoyun Dying.gif|frame|none|link=File:Song of the Heart Sword CG Ruoyun Dying.mp4]]</div>
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 26.ogg}} '''Ruoyun of the Past:''' ...I'm... still alive...? Did I... make it...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 27.ogg}} '''Ruoyun of the Past:''' ...If that wasn't enough... What do I do now... Everyone has...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 28.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' You have already done more than enough.

:<div style="margin: 2px 0px">[[File:Song of the Heart Sword CG Hsin Saving Ruoyun.gif|frame|none|link=File:Song of the Heart Sword CG Hsin Saving Ruoyun.mp4]]</div>
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 29.ogg}} '''Ruoyun of the Past:''' ...What...? Is that... the Sentinel's... voice?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 30.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' Your will and heart have reached me. The rest is for me to handle.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 31.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' Ruoyun. In a moment, you will die from your wounds. But I offer you a choice—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 32.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' Cast aside your mortal body and become part of Xuanfang Hold, guarding it for what may be eternity. Or accept the peace of death here.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 33.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' Endless restraint, or quiet release. I wish to know what you can truly accept.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 34.ogg}} '''Ruoyun of the Past:''' ...I gave my word that I'd be one of the Celestials... I want to keep... protecting my people.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 35.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' This path is not easy. Time may wither your spirit. There will be no turning back... even if you beg.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 36.ogg}} '''Ruoyun of the Past:''' ...I'll let... my future self... worry about the regrets.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 37.ogg}} '''Hsin of the Past:''' Then entrust the whole of your being to {{Rubi|me|Xuanfang Hold}}.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 38.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' —To be a Celestial is to accept a leash. You bind your life to the Hold and swear never to reveal its secrets.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 39.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' But this crisis is endangering its people. I did what I had to and projected my consciousness into an Autopuppet to guide you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 40 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 40 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' And you can speak the truth now because of this? Why only now?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 41.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' The restrictions have been lifted for now. Likely because we're near the core data zone, and your connection to the Sentinel has grown stronger.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 42 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 42 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Then tell me, what is this place? And how is it connected to the Hold?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 43.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' You're in the Hold's control mainframe, a space called the <b>Xuanyuan Domain</b>. It stores vast amounts of the region's historical data.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 44.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' Muyu uploaded outside Reverberations, twisting the execution logic. He tried to take full control of the Mirage Realm, but it ended up triggering all these anomalies.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 45.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' If this continues, his Reverberations will continue their contamination until everything collapses. In the end... the Hold itself will fall.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 46.ogg}} '''Muffled Voice:''' First Instance activated...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 47.ogg}} '''Muffled Voice:''' Simulating... Xuanfang Hold... Reconstructing... Future possibilities converged...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 55 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 55 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (This voice. It sounds like the one I heard in Rinascita's <b>Civilization Capsule</b>. If Imperator wasn't the only Sentinel that left a relic storing legacy data...)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 48 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 48 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Is this control mainframe actually a {{Extra Effect|Civilization Capsule|Civilization Capsule|A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.}}? Could we be inside it right now?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 49.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' I... That data is restricted under the highest clearance. Even now, it hasn't lifted.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 50.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' There's the lightway to the Skyend Barrier. This is as far as I can take you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 51.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' Muyu turned guardians into killers, and souls of the departed into toys. I beg you... Please stop him.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 52.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I accept your request. Take care.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 53.ogg}} '''Ruoyun:''' Qingxiao, do you remember... our farewell back then? You never gave me an answer.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 550 54.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...It was worth it.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 1.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, you have both worked very hard indeed.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 2.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...Hsin?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 3.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Thanks to the two of you and the people of this city, the Reverberation corruption in the control mainframe was largely purged. I handled the anomalies that remained.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 4.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' With the mainframe restored, the Censure Courts and Autopuppets will function as they should. The Tacet Discords will be contained in due time.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 5.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' In short... Xuanfang Hold has weathered the storm.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 6.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Uh... Paragon Qingxiao! Calm yourself!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 7.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Where exactly have you been all this time?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Xuanfang has bled again and again, and its Sentinel was nowhere to be seen. Whatever your reasons were, you owe us an explanation.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 10.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Very well. Then let us begin with the chaos Muyu sowed.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 11.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' When Muyu invaded the Sanctum, I was not blind to it. But for certain reasons, I could neither intervene directly nor send word.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 12.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' In desperation, I trapped him inside the Xuanyuan Domain, within the mainframe, and strengthened the barrier to keep him from escaping.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 13.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I believed he sought to extract the mainframe's core data. But to break my restrictions, he weaponized the Reverberations to collapse the mainframe itself.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 30 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 30 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Hold on. Back in the Sanctum, the Prism of Fate flickered. Was that you? Did you guide us into the Xuanyuan Domain?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 31.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Only by stopping Muyu's chaos from within, together with my power, could we minimize the harm that spilled beyond.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 14 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 14 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' One more thing. Is the Hold's control mainframe actually Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule? Muyu certainly believed it was.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 15.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Not entirely. It is merely one small part of it...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 16.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' This situation exceeded even my calculations. Fortunately, you two were there. You saved Xuanfang from far greater loss.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 17.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The Rafter Kite that led me to Fogveil Pagoda... You used the excuse of a meeting to lead me straight to {{Rover}}, didn't you?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 18.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Heh... so you figured it out after all.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 19.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' With my clever {{Rubi|ally|Suisui}} placing the Arbiter on the board as a wild card, I rather hoped you two would form a natural partnership.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 20.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The visions of Xuanfang we saw in the Domain...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 21.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I know your question. Those Cloud Shuttles and mechanisms were real, recorded blueprints. As for why they were never deployed during the Fortress and Gorges War...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 22.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Qingxiao... the answer is simple. There was not enough time.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 23.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...Time.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 24.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Besides, technology that outstrips its age is as much a curse as a blessing to the people of Mengzhou. It was never meant for the mortal world. It has already warped too many fates.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 25.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Muyu's ruin is proof enough of where that path leads.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 26 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 26 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I'm not here to judge your past choices. But if some of Xuanfang's problems began with its Sentinel, then its Sentinel should see them through.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 27.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Arbiter... I...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 28.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Arbiter, Paragon Qingxiao. When the time is right, I will give you and Xuanfang the answers you deserve.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 640 29.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' When that day comes, bring the Prism of Fate and come see...

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 1.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' ...Thank goodness you're both safe. Yangyang, come closer and let me get a good look at you. Are you hurt?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Suisui, I really am fine... {{Rover}} and Paragon Qingxiao are the ones who went into the Sanctum. They faced all the real danger.
:{{DIcon}} Yangyang didn't miss a single beat out there.
:{{DIcon}} She's become one of Xuanfang's bulwarks now.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 5.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' {{Rover}}, please don't praise me like that in front of my sister...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 6.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Alright, alright. Enough flattery, you two. Let's talk business. I'm speaking as Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild now.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 8.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' After returning to Mengzhou, I used the Guild's connections to dig into Muyu's past and contacted the main branch of Zhuojun Atelier.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 9.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Muyu was a prodigy in Automata Mechanics. He designed Yuan Fortress two centuries ago, was a senior figure in Zhuojun Atelier, and had deep collaborations with Huaxu Academy.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 10.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' About twenty years back, he was supposed to succeed the Flowerveil Puppet as the next Grand Helm. Instead, he announced his departure from the organization and vanished.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 11.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' After that... he probably hid in Xuanfang under another identity. Biding his time. Refining his plan.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 12.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' The Atelier has officially cut ties with him. They even offered to share information to help with the Guild's investigation.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 13.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' But we know he was still receiving internal support through an informant. Oh, right, did you meet the Cat of the Nether Lamp?
:{{DIcon}} (Tell Suisui about Jingran.)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 15.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' ...Really? So he hasn't been seen since the Sanctum... Typical. A proper ghost of the Jianghu. I wouldn't be surprised if he just shows up again one day.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 16 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 16 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I'm sure he also made it out safely.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 17 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 17 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' But did Muyu have dealings with the Fractsidus? He mentioned an Overseer's name before we ended him.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 18.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' We've only got one lead, from the Grand Helm herself. She said Muyu traded technology with the Fractsidus years ago, but the relationship didn't last.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 19.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Hard to say if that's true or just the Atelier trying to cover its tracks.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 20.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' These past few days... besides investigating the Atelier, I also made a trip to Mengzhou City Hall.
:{{DIcon}} You went there again...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 22.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Hmph. In Jinzhou, at least they served me tea while I waited. This time... they shut the door in my face. Said Mengzhou's Magistrate wasn't receiving visitors.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 23.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Xuanfang's been hit by one disaster after another, yet City Hall remains eerily quiet. It's suspicious.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 24.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' At least it has made good on its promise: a group of personnel and supplies will arrive from Mengzhou City soon. Another shipment of aid from Jinzhou has also arrived.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 25.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Things are indeed looking up. You two needn't worry about City Hall, I'll think of something.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 26 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 26 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Thank you, Suisui.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 27.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Your tone betrays you, darling. I can tell there's a lot on your mind. But you'll try to unwind, won't you?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 28 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 28 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Yeah... Things are peaceful in Xuanfang for now.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 29.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I hope that won't change for a long, long time.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 30.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Very soon, the Waking Moon Festival will be celebrated across Mengzhou. Xuanfang will be no exception. You should both take the chance to relax.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 650 31.ogg}} '''Suisui:''' Well then, see you soon. Don't forget about our... "next time," alright, {{Rover}}?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 651 1.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' {{Rover}}, what did my sister mean by "next time"...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 651 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 651 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...One day, we're all gonna visit Jinzhou together.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 651 3.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I'd like that.

;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Head to Qingxiao's training hall in the Eastern Xuan Peaks
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 1.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' You're here.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...So this is your training hall?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 3.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' When I first settled here, it was nothing but an abandoned shack. Over the years, the local folk have helped me repair it of their own accord.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 4.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I owe them a great debt. Cultivation may not need worldly comforts, but if I am to found a school, I should at least have a proper training hall.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 5 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 5 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...Found a school?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 6.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I want to open a school here in Xuanfang. Teach others the way of the sword.
:{{DIcon}} So you're really coming down from the mountain after all.
:{{DIcon}} The Sword Transcendent is taking disciples now?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Where are you at with this?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 10.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...Still at the very first step. Finding my first disciple.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 11.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' The first disciple is the foundation, the face the school shows to the world. I must choose with the utmost care.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 12 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 12 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Well, you did teach me to fly with a sword not long ago. Doesn't that mean...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 29.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Back in the Xuanyuan Domain, I called you "disciple," yes. And you called me "master." But that journey has already ended.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 30.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I have not truly guided you. Your swordcraft already stands on its own. I've no right to claim you as disciple.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 31.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' So... it must be your choice.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 32 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 32 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Qingxiao. If you'll have me, then our journey doesn't need to be over.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 33.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...Very well.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 34.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' According to how my own master accepted me, taking on a disciple requires two steps. This shall be the first.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 17 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 17 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' This is...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 18.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' A sword talisman. I carved it myself over the last few days. My lifebound Sword Intent lives inside it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 35.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Think of it as a keepsake of our knowing each other... or as a bond between master and disciple. I hope you will take it.
:{{DIcon}} (Accept it solemnly)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 22.ogg}} '''Jingwei of the Past:''' To be my disciple, you must sever worldly ties, cast aside the six desires, and leave karma behind.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 23.ogg}} '''Qingxiao of the Past:''' And if, in the end, I cannot?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 24.ogg}} '''Jingwei of the Past:''' Then by that time, you will have found a Way of your own.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 26 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 26 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So, now comes the second step, I guess?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 27.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I treat you to a meal.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 28.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' I believe it's called an Initiation Feast. When my master accepted me, she broke years of fasting just to share a meal.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 37.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Bring along your adorable little friend as well.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 38 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 660 38 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' "Adorable"... You mean Abby?

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 1.ogg}} '''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar—coming right up! Caught from the Luo River just this morning. You won't find fresher!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 2.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Mmm, yum-yum-yum-yum-yum!

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 4.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' This was the signature dish of "Yuan's Flavors" in the late Fortress. I received an invitation to eat there once. One bite, and the taste has never left me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 5.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Disciple, would you like to try some?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 6.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Before I always saw the people... as those who quietly waited to be protected.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 7.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' But the truth is, they've always had the heart to protect themselves.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 8.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' To save for a day, or to save for a lifetime... Neither compares to teaching them the means to save themselves.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So... that's the real reason you're founding a school?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 10.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Many years ago, a fellow Cultivator passed through Xuanfang with his disciple during their travels across Huanglong. He came up the mountain to visit me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 11.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Only then did I learn that to solve Temporal Disruption for future generations, he had to set a plan in motion with a "{{Rubi|golden-eyed one|you}}" at Mt. Firmament. It cost him dearly. His lifespan was nearly spent.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 12.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' And yet, he was at total peace. He had a disciple to inherit his legacy, and his teachings were already taking root across the world.
:{{DIcon}} Master Xuanmiao... and Changli?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 14.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Even if one can no longer walk their Way, or devote their life to "peace under heaven," there will always be... someone to take their place.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 15.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' That is the lesson you taught me, not so long ago.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 16 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 16 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So, as your first and most devoted disciple, it looks like I'll be helping with the teaching too.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 17.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' ...You already have.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 18.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' To teach the sword is to offer someone a chance to find their own way with it. Even if they never master it, their body and spirit will still become stronger.
:{{DIcon}} Speaking of which, what are you naming the school?
:{{DIcon}} What should I say if someone asks where I've studied?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 21.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' Well...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 22.ogg}} '''Excited Kid:''' Did you hear? That Transcendent lady is incredible! They say she's the master of the greatest martial arts school in the whole wide world!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 23.ogg}} '''Confused Kid:''' What's it called again?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 24.ogg}} '''Excited Kid:''' Uh, Xuan... Xuanyuan School! Yeah, it's the best in the world!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 665 25.ogg}} '''Qingxiao:''' In that case... Xuanyuan School it shall be.
:'''In this life, we part more than we gather. Nine times out of ten, the world is not as we wish.'''

==Glossary==
* Civilization Capsule - A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.
* Dollmaker - The leader of the Séance Society, formerly a disciple under Yinlin's parents.
* Fortress and Gorges War - A large-scale war that broke out simultaneously in the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress, aimed at preventing the spread of the Tacet Discord Outbreak from the Norfall Barrens into Huanglong via the Land of Xuanfang. Following this war, Jinzhou was formally established. Yuan Fortress was ultimately destroyed during the war, and Xuanfang Hold was later constructed upon its ruins.
* Inner Landscape - An inner world that only a small number of cultivators can enter during deep meditation, where every blade of grass and every tree is a projection of the mind. This mirage realm is also known by the more common name "Mindscape."
* Lifebound Sword Intent - A unique frequency of Sword Intent split off by Qingxiao, condensing her most essential and purest Resonance Energy.
* Lynx Spirit - A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.
* Ministry of Foreign Affairs - An administrative bureau based in Shaftpost Yard. Inspection Officers are responsible for recording and verifying goods and commodities entering the Hold, while Constables handle identity checks for entrants and oversee security operations throughout the region.
* Prism of Fate - A token created from Hsin the Moon Fox's own frequency. It contains part of the Sentinel's authority.
* Reeling Fog - An anomalous fog mixed with Reverberations. A mutated form of Disorienting Fog, it appears to disrupt the normal operation of machinery. Prolonged exposure destabilizes a Resonator's Resonance Ability and can induce Overclocking.
* Xuan Shield - A mechanical defensive barrier activated only when Xuanfang Hold enters a state of emergency. It is vast enough to enshroud the entire Hold. It served as a crucial line of protection during the earlier siege by the Autopuppets.

==Trivia==
* Jianghu (江湖), "Rivers and Lake, Where Waters Meet." It is a romanticized term often used in Chinese and Wuxia literatures, to represent a gathering of different type of people from the underbelly of society to large factions. There's various versions, but it's often associated to gangs.
* Shifu (师父) means Teacher or Master, someone who is a master of their profession and teaches those knowledge. 
* Sanshi Poison, Three Corpses Poison (三尸毒), physiological belief that demonic creatures live inside the human body, and they seek to hasten the death of their host.<ref>https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three_Corpses</ref> It is believed that killing the Three Corpses allow one to ascend to deitihood. When one passes away, the Three Corpses would leave the body and become ghosts. <ref>https://chinesecultureinenglish.wordpress.com/2024/04/18/three-corpses-%E4%B8%89%E5%B0%B8/</ref>
